-- CA-6: Kiley (Ind.) leads, 2nd spot between Stansfield (R) and Pan (D) separated by ~1%
UPDATE house_races 
SET notes = 'Ballots still counting as of Jun 3. Kevin Kiley (Ind., incumbent) leads at 26.8%. Second spot uncalled: Michael Stansfield (R) at 22.2% vs Richard Pan (D) at 21.2% — separated by ~1%. Est. 116,000 ballots remaining. AP has not called the 2nd spot. (Source: NBC News / AP, 47.8% in)',
    candidate2_name = 'TBD — Stansfield (R) 22.2% vs Pan (D) 21.2%',
    candidate1_name = 'Kevin Kiley (Ind., leading 26.8%)'
WHERE state_code = 'CA' AND district = '6';

Est. 120,000 ballots remaining in Sacramento County alone. AP has not called the 2nd spot. (Source: NYT / AP, 47% in)',
    candidate2_name = 'TBD — Vang (D) 24.9% vs Wooden (R) 24.1%',
    candidate2_party = 'D'

-- CA-22: Valadao (R) called, 2nd spot between Villegas (D) and Bains (D) — Villegas leads by ~4%

    candidate1_name = 'TBD — Villegas (D) 29.8% vs Bains (D) 25.7%'
WHERE state_code = 'CA' AND district = '22';
